normal_convention: Native PhysX collider-order normal, retained signed; not independently asserted force-on-cup direction. Local z near0 describes predominantly straight side-wall normal, not measured pressure-centre torque.
input_geometry_scope: Frozen registered convex-hull input bounds and actual logged collider prim; effective cooked hull not independently inspected.
first_contact_selection: Strictly positive impulse norm; exact physics_step/t alignment; excludes zero-impulse speculative points and lost callbacks.
